top_violation_types.title: Annual Fire Inspection - Before Initial Permit Issued and Every 12 Months (26 TAC §746.5101(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have a current fire inspection.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - 24 Annual training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(5)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The staff files reviewed did not have the required Health and Safety training topic certificates for the last full year of training.

top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The grassy area on one of the operations playgrounds was found to have a deep step down with the sprinkler system being exposed.

top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Fenced Outdoor Activity Space (26 TAC §746.4305)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation no longer has  a fenced outdoor area.

top_violation_types.title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on the gatherings during the investigation, it was determined concrete evidence exists to support that the school have not followed the instructions on the sanitizing solution.

top_violation_types.title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Age-appropriate (26 TAC §746.2505(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A nap mat was observed torn while a child was sleeping on it.
